svg.text: UML sequence diagram. Ordered messages between the participants of section 2.3, each labelled with its protocol and port.
forward through the API load balancer
HTTPS 443, SSA to HSA, across the internal firewall
create the account, state Registered, PBKDF2 password hash
queue the six-digit e-mail verification code, stored hashed
POST /app/account/user-profile and /id-image, profile, identity image and face photo
store both, AES-GCM encrypted at rest
state Approved, QR badge issued, OperationLog entry
verify the stored hash, write the hashed one-time code
queue the one-time code, single use and time limited
access token, 5-minute cap, and a rotating refresh token
Gate scan on the forum days
validate the badge, the approval state and the gate's allowed profile types; record the scan idempotently
Message, numbered, with its protocol and port
Participants, zones, protocols and ports: the Communication Requirements Matrix, SIMF-HLD-004 section 2.8.
Endpoint paths: the FastEndpoints route declarations in the SIMF solution source tree.
Every attendee message crosses the WAF and load balancer and then SIMF.MobileEdge. That chain is drawn in full at steps 1 to 3 and elided afterwards, which each arrow states.
The API load balancer forwards and does not participate, so it is folded into the SIMF.Api lifeline rather than given one of its own.
A dashed arrow is a reply, a solid arrow a call.
